sonnet.problem: The card says Kore's men "share out portions to the priests and Levites in their cities, old and young, families included." Verse 15 says only that portions went to fellow priests in their cities, "old and young alike." Levites are mentioned separately in verse 17, with no city given. Verse 18 says the genealogy included the little ones, wives, sons and daughters. It does not say portions were handed to the families. The card merges these verses and adds details the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes. / Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
